description: Source code implementing support for reading and decompressing gzip (.gz) compressed files within the FreeType project, including header parsing, stream management, and optional zlib integration.

classes.name: FT_GZipFileRec
classes.description: Structure representing a gzip file stream, including buffers, zlib stream, and position tracking.

methods.name: ft_gzip_check_header
methods.description: Checks and skips the gzip header in a stream, verifying magic numbers and optional fields.

methods.name: ft_gzip_file_init
methods.description: Initializes a gzip file structure, setting up zlib stream and header position.

methods.name: ft_gzip_file_done
methods.description: Finalizes and frees resources associated with a gzip file structure.

methods.name: ft_gzip_file_reset
methods.description: Resets the gzip file stream to the start of compressed data.

methods.name: ft_gzip_file_fill_input
methods.description: Fills the zlib input buffer with data from the source stream.

methods.name: ft_gzip_file_fill_output
methods.description: Decompresses data into the output buffer using zlib inflate.

methods.name: ft_gzip_file_skip_output
methods.description: Skips a specified number of decompressed bytes in the output buffer.

methods.name: ft_gzip_file_io
methods.description: Reads or seeks data from the gzip file stream at a given position.

methods.name: ft_gzip_stream_close
methods.description: Closes and frees resources of the gzip stream.

methods.name: ft_gzip_stream_io
methods.description: Performs I/O operations on the gzip stream at a specified offset.

methods.name: ft_gzip_get_uncompressed_size
methods.description: Retrieves the uncompressed size of the gzip file from its footer.

methods.name: FT_Stream_OpenGzip
methods.description: Opens a stream for reading gzip compressed data, handling header verification and optional in-memory loading.

methods.name: FT_Gzip_Uncompress
methods.description: Decompresses input data into an output buffer using zlib inflate, modeled after zlib's uncompress.
